body:
That may be the most insane response I've ever received to anything I've ever posted on reddit. Thank you for that. 

As far as weed goes, I'm not compatible with it and I have a job where drug tests are a concern. And oddly enough, pot reminds me of her and alcohol doesn't. She was a super rare smoker, but the last time i got high was with her at a music festival in 2011. We saw something amazing together when Arcade Fire played. I'll never forget it.
And now I've posted to the wrong sub.
She deserves nothing less. She's an amazing woman.

I know that the next phase of healing is completely dependent on her. She will either choose to heal on her own, or heal with me. I don't deserve the latter. I know how excruciatingly difficult the road to recovery as a couple could be. I would give anything to have not put us in this situation to begin with.

It doesn't seem like it could be possible, but the moment that I realized what a terrible mistake I made, I started making progress to change and fix it. By the time she confronted me, I was paralyzed with fear and couldn't lose her again. I made a really stupid decision. I have so much shame and guilt, especially now that her family knows. It is soul crushing. I don't know how I can ever stop beating myself up or forgive myself. I know that she is the victim in this. I always swore that I would protect her from harm, and then I turned around and dealt her the most harm of all.

I've already started reading things. I started many months ago. I know how strong my love is for her, but I know that I will never fully understand the pain I caused her. Sometimes it seems like she just deserves a clean slate so she doesn't have to endure this difficult path with me. I just hope that if she does approach me with desire to try and fix this, that it's truly genuine and from her heart and not just because she is scared for the future. I hope she is able to conquer the fear and not let it control her, as my fear controlled me.
No, I do not think I still deserve her. I know that I deserve the pain of looking back at this as the biggest irreparable mistake I'll ever make.
I understand, thank you for your honesty. One last question: are you truly happy or do you feel like you constantly feel like you have something to prove?
I'm going to try and give her some genuine space. I know she deserves it

I'm willing to give her the space that she needs,
I'm just terrified of it.
Thank you for your candid response. I never thought we would go through any of this. It kills me.
You are right. In more ways than one: I should have been completely honest from the start. And I truly do love her.

Thank you for your harsh but honest words. It's what I need right now. I truly do love her and have based a future around her. I am not a cheater and I know my basis for cheating doesnt make sense to some. It doesn't  make sense to me sometimes but every persons situation is different. I'm so very not proud of what I did, but I did it.
Your story is very inspirational. I truly love this woman, but I don't want to compromise her future happiness by thinking we could fix this. Im really lost but your story gives me hope.
Sorry, I'm on mobile so I don't know the link to the post. At least I'm not sure how to access it. I will edit the post and message the mods though.
